page.overview:
Who is Recruit?

Killed a Queen.}}The unidentified recruit is the main human protagonist of Aliens: Unleashed. He is a member of the United States Colonial Marine Corps.

The recruit is a newbie within the corp, at first trains themself with synthetic recreation of the xenomorphs. During this training, the synthetic suddenly malfuncioned and started killings members of the corp around the barracks, leading to the marine forcing himself to fight each of the creatures in order to get to other locations within the ship.

When the marine found out that the company plans have caged some xenomorphs on a ship within the moon for future resreach, he inflitrated the ship and take down severals guards only to receive another message that the xenomorphs has broke out again, wiping any other marine forces and left him as the last standing personnel on the base.

Now knowing this, the marine crashed the ship down to a unidentified planet, killing all xenomorphs including a queen. After the events of the game, he is promoted.
